answer_1.quote: A good open-domain conversational agent should have a well-rounded set of skills and qualities that allow it to seamlessly blend listening with empathy, providing knowledgeable responses, and talking about various topics from everyday life to their favorite hobbies or latest challenges.

answer_2.quote: For automated metrics, we report hits@1 on the test set (or validation set in the case of ConvAI2 as the test set is not publicly available), out of 20 candidates for ConvAI2, and 100 candidates for ED and WoW, following the original datasets.

answer_4.quote: We ask workers to chat with various models and then rate the conversation along several axes: • Knowledge: How knowledgeable was your chat partner (from 1: not at all, to 5: very)? • Empathy: Did the responses of your chat partner show understanding of your feelings (from 1: not at all, to 5: very much)? • Personal: How much did your chat partner talk about themselves (from 1: not at all, to 5: a lot)? • Overall: Overall, how much would you like to have a long conversation with this conversation partner (from 1: not at all, to 5: a lot)?
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to rate the conversation along several axes: Knowledge, Empathy, Personal, and Overall.
